payload.title: Oceania Wedding Destinations From Fiji to Tahiti
payload.excerpt: Oceania wedding destinations run from the islands of Melanesia and Polynesia to New Zealand, Hawaii and Australia's own reef islands. What separates them for a wedding is the calendar, the paperwork and how easily your guests get there.
key_takeaways: Ten places, unranked, in four groups: Melanesia (Fiji, Vanuatu, New Caledonia), Polynesia (Tahiti and French Polynesia, the Cook Islands, Samoa, Tonga, Hawaii), New Zealand and the Whitsundays.
As at November 2026, Smartraveller dates Fiji's cyclone season from November to April, so a covered ceremony space and a buffer day belong in the plan for much of the tropical South Pacific.
The legal route differs by country, from a Ministry of Justice licence in the Cook Islands or a state licence in Hawaii to a symbolic ceremony in Fiji with the legal marriage at home.
For season and legal route side by side, jump to [the at-a-glance table](#oceania-wedding-destinations-at-a-glance).

faq.q: Which places in Oceania suit a wedding abroad?
faq.a: Fiji, Vanuatu, New Caledonia, Tahiti and French Polynesia, the Cook Islands, Samoa, Tonga, Hawaii, New Zealand and the Whitsundays, each with its own season and legal route.

faq.q: When is cyclone season in the South Pacific?
faq.a: As at November 2026, Smartraveller dates it from November to April for Fiji, Vanuatu, French Polynesia, the Cook Islands, Samoa and Tonga, and November to May for New Caledonia, with storms possible outside those months.

faq.q: Can we marry legally in the Cook Islands?
faq.a: Yes, with a licence from the Ministry of Justice, issued three days after you both give notice in person unless a waiver is granted. The ceremony must take place at the site the licence names.
Hawaii sits in Polynesia, so it belongs here, but it is a US state north of the equator, with a wetter winter from October to April.

faq.q: Is a wedding in Tahiti legal or symbolic?
faq.a: Either. For a legal marriage, the mairie of the commune advises on requirements and documents, which may include a CNI and a Certificat de Coutume.

Weigh them up with Wedded Concierge.'), before 'What to plan for a wedding in the Pacific', per 09-cro.json. 08-final.md has no <!-- CTA: primary --> marker, so nothing was replaced and no CTA marker comments were added; the sentence and link are unchanged.
